## Details

<a id="fighter_pieces"></a>
### [`fighter_pieces`](../../../../src/graphics/fighter_pieces_0840.asm#L6) `$0840-$43FF`

*data*

Fighter body pieces 1-$ef: 64 bytes each, at $0800 + 64 * piece number. Each piece has the sprite format: 21 rows of 3 bytes, multicolour. The 64th byte is not used. A frame record ($bc16) gives 9 piece numbers for a grid of 3 x 3 pieces. $88c0 copies the non-zero bytes of each piece into the composition buffer at $05ca.
